## Steps

### `python-model`

1. Checkout: `actions/checkout@v4`
2. Setup Python: `actions/setup-python@v5`
3. Install Python verification dependencies: `python3 -m venv .venv_ci; source .venv_ci/bin/activate; python -m pip install --upgrade pip; python -m pip install -r requirements.txt`
4. Run reference model checks: `source .venv_ci/bin/activate; bash scripts/check-python-model.sh`
5. Upload reference model artifacts: `actions/upload-artifact@v4`

### `native-sim`
